value.title: Phase 1: Knob to screen over BLE
value.summary: Prove BLE, port the decoder test-first, show the knob on screen.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: Work top to bottom. Hardware smoke steps that take the knob from the Mac or touch the amp wait for Vaughan's go-ahead.

value.title: Spike: throwaway NimBLE-Arduino sketch in /tmp/bluos-ble-spike bonds to ANTICATER_MINI and prints raw Report notifications
value.success: Go/no-go verdict, payload form and bonding quirks recorded in the execution log; spike code discarded

value.title: Scaffold firmware/ PlatformIO project (espressif32 Arduino + M5Unified + NimBLE-Arduino; envs m5stick and native) and justfile fw-build/fw-test/fw-flash/fw-monitor via uvx
value.success: `just fw-build` succeeds; `just fw-test` runs (empty) native suite; .pio ignored

value.title: RED: native tests for knob_core decoder with Test Doc blocks: real capture vectors (03e900 … 030000), report-id-less forms, unknown usage
value.success: Tests compile and fail for the missing decoder

value.title: GREEN: implement knob_core decoder (16-bit LE usage scan + release rule, same table as normalizer.py)
BLE knob adapter: scan for ANTICATER name, bond, subscribe to HID reports, enqueue raw payloads to a bounded FreeRTOS queue; reconnect with backoff; serial `bonds clear`
value.success: Adapter compiles; callback does no work beyond enqueue

value.title: Screen v1 + serial log: board name at boot, knob link state, last action + counter; one JSON-ish action line per event on serial
value.success: Renders on the detected M5 model

value.title: Hardware smoke (Vaughan's go-ahead: unpairs knob from Mac): flash, bond, every gesture shows on screen + serial; knob power-cycle reconnects
value.success: Recorded in execution log with serial excerpts

tk-2101.assertion: Serial shows raw notification bytes for turn up/down and press
Verdict + constraints written to execution log

tk-2103.assertion: just fw-test fails on decoder assertions before implementation

tk-2106.assertion: Boot screen shows detected board name
Action line format documented in code

tk-2107.assertion: Each of up/down/mute/brightness± seen on screen
